rationale: This is a cosmetic extension of the archive's best signal GoodwillCapexSupportBurden (identical goodwill-share trigger and capx/ppent-vs-margin spread, merely padded with inventory and R&D legs), so it cannot cleanly demonstrate incremental information and risks diluting an already strong result.

The construction is internally consistent and the trigger/condition roles are a genuine rearrangement rather than a repeat of ProcessRDCapexCostRelief, though it reuses the same three ingredients and the COALESCE(xrd,0) delta will pile non-R&D firms at a tied zero trigger, weakening the interaction.

This is KnowledgeOperatingLeverage (ls_alpha 4.6%, t=4.97) with sales growth swapped for gross-profit-to-assets change and capex growth swapped for PP&E growth — a component substitution, not a substantively different mechanism, and the stated "tautology" motivation does not describe any defect in the original.

The conditioning spread is verbatim from PPEIntensityCostPressureNoRD and the asset-age trigger is already used in three archived signals, so only the multiplier is new and the proposal amounts to a recombination rather than a new economic channel.

Economically coherent and correctly signed, but it simply pairs the archived ShortDebtIntangibleCollateralMismatch trigger with the archived CapacityInventoryNoInnovation spread, and the earlier short-debt result came out strongly against its hypothesized sign without that diagnosis being addressed here.

Near-rediscovery of CashFundedKnowledgeOption (same cash-change trigger times an R&D-minus-physical-intensity spread, which tested weak at t=1.17), with the only change being noisier per-employee R&D and PP&E-to-sales substitutes.
